name: Marie Sklodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowship - Global Fellowship (MSCA PF-GF)
amount: Living allowance, mobility allowance and family/leave/special-needs allowances where applicable, plus research, training and networking costs
other_rules: Only nationals or long-term residents of an EU member state or Horizon Europe associated country (Indian nationals without EU long-term residence are not eligible)
1-2 years at a host outside Europe followed by a mandatory 1-year return phase in Europe
must not have lived or worked mainly in the outgoing host country for more than 12 months in the 36 months before the deadline
notes: Same call and deadline as the European Fellowship. Included for completeness; most Indian applicants should use the European Fellowship.
